title: WHY YOUR PHONE GETS HOT WHILE CHARGING
subject: technology

beats.narration: Your phone warms up while it charges, even when you never touch it. That heat is not a defect. It is physics you are paying for.
beats.claim: charging a phone always produces some waste heat
beats.visual_question: where does charging heat come from?
beats.visual_answer: the charge path itself, glowing inside the phone

beats.narration: To charge, the charger pushes current into the battery, and lithium ions shuffle from one electrode to the other to store the energy.
beats.claim: charging stores energy by moving lithium ions between electrodes
beats.visual_question: what is the battery actually doing while it charges?
beats.visual_answer: ions crossing the cell from cathode to anode

beats.narration: Nothing that carries current is perfect. The cable, the charge chip, and the battery's own inner resistance all fight the flow.
beats.claim: every part of the charge path has electrical resistance
beats.visual_question: what stands between the plug and the battery?
beats.visual_answer: a chain of parts, each resisting the current a little

beats.narration: That fight turns a few percent of the charging power straight into heat. Fast charging pushes far more power through the same resistance.
beats.claim: a few percent of charging power dissipates as heat; fast charging increases it
beats.visual_question: where does the lost power go?
beats.visual_answer: a split of power in versus heat out, growing with charge rate

beats.narration: So when the phone runs warm, it defends itself. Charging slows down on purpose, to protect the battery.
beats.claim: phones reduce charging current when the battery runs hot
beats.visual_question: why does fast charging slow down after a while?
beats.visual_answer: the charge curve flattening under a thermal limit

beats.narration: The warmth is the receipt. Energy moved fast leaves a little behind as heat. The phone is not failing. It is paying the toll.
beats.claim: charging heat is the unavoidable cost of moving energy fast
beats.visual_question: so what is the heat, really?
beats.visual_answer: the phone reprised calm: warmth as the receipt for fast energy
